description:
Get GlassDoor Job Details

Fetches a Glassdoor job posting by its vacancy URL. Returns job title, company name and rating, location, salary estimate, posted date, full job description, and qualifications/benefits. Use for ATS ingestion, job aggregators, comp benchmarking, enrichment of company profiles, and feeding descriptions into LLM matching or resume-tailoring pipelines.

url.description: The URL of the job vacancy to retrieve details for.
